title: Prophet ‘Isa (AS)
intro: ‘Isa son of Maryam (AS): his miraculous birth, his miracles, and what the Qur’an teaches about him.

learn.html: A very special person mentioned throughout the Qur’an is the chosen messenger ‘Isa (AS), son of Maryam. His whole life is remarkable: being conceived without a father, speaking as a baby, his miracles, his life and his leaving this world. Allah tells us about these events in detail, and we should believe about them first of all what is said or mentioned in the Qur’an.
‘Isa (AS) comes from one of the most chosen families – the family of ‘Imran, the family of his mother, Maryam.

learn.title: 📖 Maryam in the Qur’an
learn.html: Her Lord accepted her kindly, made her grow up beautifully, and put her in the care of Zakariyya. Whenever Zakariyya came to her in the place of prayer, he found food with her. “Where did you get this, Maryam?” he asked. She said: “It is from Allah. Allah provides for whom He wills without measure.” <small>(Qur’an, Al ‘Imran 3:37, meaning)</small>

The coming of ‘Isa (AS) into this world was special and unique, because by Allah’s decree he was born without a father. The angel Jibril breathed into Maryam, and she became pregnant. Because Maryam had no husband, her family and people attacked her, so by Allah’s decree she went away to a place by a palm tree with a stream flowing beneath it.

learn.title: 📖 The baby speaks
learn.html: She came back to her people carrying him. “O Maryam,” they said, “you have done something unheard of! O sister of Harun, your father was not a bad man and your mother was not unchaste.” She pointed to the baby. “How can we talk to a baby in the cradle?” they said. He said: “I am Allah’s servant. He will give me the Book and make me a prophet. He made me blessed wherever I am, and told me to pray and give charity as long as I live, and to be good to my mother; He did not make me arrogant or disobedient. Peace be on me the day I was born, the day I die and the day I am raised to life again!” That is ‘Isa, son of Maryam – the word of truth about which they argue. <small>(Qur’an, Maryam 19:27–34, meaning)</small>

learn.title: 📖 Al-Ma’idah 5:110
learn.html: Allah will say: “O ‘Isa, son of Maryam, remember My blessing on you and your mother: when I supported you with Jibril, so you spoke to people in the cradle and as a grown man; when I taught you writing and wisdom, the Tawrat and the Injil; when you made from clay the shape of a bird by My permission, breathed into it, and it became a bird by My permission; when you healed the blind and the leper by My permission; when you brought the dead back to life by My permission; and when I held back the Children of Isra’il from you when you brought them clear proofs, and those of them who disbelieved said: ‘This is nothing but clear magic!’” <small>(meaning)</small>

items.label: Spoke as a baby in the cradle
Made a bird of clay that flew – by Allah’s permission
Healed the blind and the leper – by Allah’s permission
Brought the dead back to life – by Allah’s permission

learn.text: ‘Isa is not the son of God, and he was not killed

learn.title: 📖 An-Nisa’ 4:171
learn.html: O People of the Book, do not go too far in your religion, and say only the truth about Allah. The Messiah, ‘Isa son of Maryam, was only a messenger of Allah, and His word which He sent to Maryam, and a soul from Him. So believe in Allah and His messengers, and do not say “Three”. Stop – it is better for you! Allah is only One God – glory be to Him, far above having a son! To Him belongs everything in the heavens and on earth, and Allah is enough as a Protector. <small>(meaning)</small>

learn.title: 📖 An-Nisa’ 4:157–158
learn.html: …and because of their saying: “We killed the Messiah, ‘Isa son of Maryam, Allah’s messenger.” They did not kill him and did not crucify him – it was only made to seem so to them. Those who argue about it are in doubt; they have no real knowledge, only guesses. Certainly they did not kill him – rather, Allah raised him up to Himself. Allah is Almighty and Wise. (meaning)

learn.title: 📖 Al-Ma’idah 5:116–117
learn.html: When Allah will say: “O ‘Isa son of Maryam, did you tell people: ‘Take me and my mother as two gods besides Allah’?” he will say: “Glory be to You! It was not for me to say what I had no right to say. If I had said it, You would know it. You know what is in me, and I do not know what is in You. Only You know all that is hidden. I told them only what You commanded me: ‘Worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord.’ I was a witness over them while I was among them, and when You took me, You were the Watcher over them.” <small>(meaning)</small>

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Without the Qur’an’s account of ‘Isa (AS), we would know nothing about him, or would only be guessing – so praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

practice.title: What the Qur’an teaches about ‘Isa (AS)
practice.prompt: Tap every true sentence, then tap Check.

options.text: He was born without a father, by Allah’s decree
He spoke as a baby in the cradle
He is Allah’s servant and messenger
His miracles happened by Allah’s permission
Allah raised him up to Himself
He is the son of God
options.why: The Qur’an says Allah is One and far above having a son – ‘Isa (AS) is His servant and messenger.

options.text: He was killed on a cross
options.why: The Qur’an says they did not kill him or crucify him – Allah raised him up to Himself.

questions.q: What was special about the birth of ‘Isa (AS)?
options: He was born without a father
He was born in a palace
He was born on a ship

questions.q: What were the first words of ‘Isa (AS) in the cradle?
Where did Maryam go to give birth?
options: To a palm tree with a stream below it

questions.q: By whose permission did ‘Isa (AS) perform his miracles?
What does the Qur’an say happened at the end of his time on earth?
options: Allah raised him up to Himself

practice.title: Questions, tasks and talk
prompts: ❓ Which family was ‘Isa (AS) born into? What was special about his birth, and why was he a special child?
❓ Whom from ‘Isa’s family does the Qur’an mention? What are his miracles?
💬 What answer would you give, kindly and politely, to someone who says ‘Isa (AS) is “the son of God”?
🔎 Choose a task: Find out how Christian beliefs about ‘Isa (AS) differ from what the Qur’an teaches. OR: Where is ‘Isa (AS) now, and what do Muslims believe about his return to the earth?
🗣️ Talk with your muallim: “‘Isa (AS) is a great unknown to those who do not read the Qur’an.”
